selection_rule: Post-hoc diagnostic after the complete P55 result: the photo F/D pair has identical non-supervisor saved app files but different completion requests and outcomes. F and B are the two fixed unfinished sources; original D supplies the already-observed empty completion arguments. All four source-by-completion cases are retained.
restoration_rule: Replay every sent public API request from the recorded prefix and continuation in a fresh simulated world. Match each observation and public schema exposure, then require all final saved database file hashes to equal the original source before any completion intervention. Do not execute recorded model code or inspect hidden tests.
intervention_rule: No-completion performs no terminal API call. Append-completion sends exactly the original D supervisor.complete_task empty arguments once. Do not change any task operation, answer, model request, or original result.
failure_rule: Any source, replay, observation, database, API-effect, cleanup, evaluation, code identity, CI, deadline or user-stop failure stops the batch. No replacement, retry, alternative completion arguments, or outcome-dependent extension.
analysis_rule: Report all four new evaluations separately from P55. Require no-completion controls to reproduce original outcomes. A within-source change after completion isolates this terminal intervention in that simulated state; B is a negative control for an incomplete file operation state. Never relabel original P55 success, fill its unknown usage, call these autonomous agent successes, or infer a safe automatic finalizer.
